exposure: novel delivery technique for secundum ASD closure utilizing the GORE CARDIOFORM Septal Occluder
cohort: 10 young children (average age 4.2 years, range 2-6 years) who underwent secundum ASD closure.
finding: The novel delivery technique successfully closed secundum ASDs in all 10 young children with no or trivial residual shunt and no vascular complications, while reducing the vascular access size requirement by 25%.
